# VegVault Changelog

```{r}
#| label: source config
#| include: FALSE
#| results: 'hide'
#| warning: FALSE
#| message: FALSE

library(here)

here::i_am("website/database_changelog.qmd")

# Load configuration
source(
  here::here(
    "R/00_Config_file.R"
  )
)
```

This page lists every version of [VegVault]{.vegvault} and gives each release its own section, newest first.
Each section says what changed against the release before it and what that means for code written for the earlier release.
Every [database]{.database} file records its version in its `version_control` table, and the R package [{vaultkeepr}](https://bit.ly/vaultkeepr), from its version 0.2.0, reads it when it opens the file.

## All versions

```{r}
#| label: changelog-versions
#| echo: false

data_version_control |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(dplyr::row_number())) |>
  dplyr::select("version", "update_date", "changelog") |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Version", "Date", "Changes")
  )
```

## VegVault 1.0.0 {#vegvault-1-0-0}

The first release of [VegVault]{.vegvault}, described in the [[VegVault]{.vegvault} data paper](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-025-06176-1).
Its [SQLite database]{.database} ([10.48700/datst.t21cz-2nq07](https://doi.org/10.48700/datst.t21cz-2nq07)) and its flat files ([10.48700/datst.thktf-5rr35](https://doi.org/10.48700/datst.thktf-5rr35)) are deposited in the [EOSC CZ data repository](https://datarepo.eosc.cz/).
